purpose: Evidence-gated future scientific subtasks for the existing supervisor. Candidates are not automatically executed without explicit --start and finite local limits.

task.objective: Only if feasibility audit supports it, preregister and run a bounded paired, matched-CPU Badger versus KelinciWCA comparison on independent Java programs; preserve null results and all raw logs.
task.failure_handling: A failed feasibility audit is a no-go, not an invitation to run an invalid benchmark.
success_criteria: independent paired units
exact resource accounting
result and uncertainty retained

task.objective: Quantify per-dimension class counts, missingness and temporal test feasibility for the separate observable cohort; evaluate Paper 3 only if the prespecified class and grouped time-split gates pass.
task.failure_handling: If class counts are sparse, report power and missingness without AUC or probabilities.
success_criteria: separate outcome counts
uncertainty and split audit
valid score or explicit no-score decision

task.objective: Create a new source-only, cutoff-frozen historical CS question mini-cohort from the existing year/topic frame, then audit dated follow-ups under the frozen trajectory rubric; report direct-label yield and missingness without scoring Paper 3 unless valid labels exist.
task.failure_handling: If direct labels remain sparse, preserve missingness and produce a valid no-score decision; do not reinterpret partial progress as resolution.
success_criteria: new source-only rows and cutoff provenance
dated follow-up audit
direct-label prevalence and Paper 3 gate reported

task.objective: Compare Paper 4's pre-action rankings and declared feasibility assumptions against the observed CAM, Badger, DP158, uncertainty-robustness and SERENIoT action outcomes; quantify only descriptive calibration/rank agreement when provenance permits, and do not call it validated planning utility.
execution_requirements: no causal utility claim from small n
task.failure_handling: If pre-action ranking or outcome provenance is insufficient, report non-identifiability and do not invent an information-gain score.
success_criteria: pre/post action provenance reconciled
observed go/no-go outcomes coded
planning utility remains gated if sample is too small

task.objective: For the three eligible rows in the independently validated Round 3 cohort, run a second frozen retrieval protocol using citation tracing plus authenticated primary full-text access; classify direct resolution, premise revision, partial progress and missingness without changing the original cohort or manufacturing labels.
execution_requirements: authenticated primary full text where available
task.failure_handling: Retain missingness when exact intervention, comparator, endpoint or date cannot be authenticated; never turn a failed search into a negative resolution label.
success_criteria: second protocol frozen before follow-up adjudication
all three rows receive provenance-coded dimension outcomes
Paper 3 score remains gated unless direct labels exist

task.objective: Independently re-analyze the frozen QAOA postselection pilot, preserving the A2 setup-infeasibility result and the A1 conditional denominator; verify that the observed delta is not promoted to a general or planner-utility claim.
task.failure_handling: If the raw result or plan hash does not verify, mark the pilot invalid and preserve the setup failure; do not repair the result by changing the frozen plan.
success_criteria: plan and raw observations independently verified
A2 infeasibility and A1 denominator reported
scope and uncertainty limitations retained

task.objective: Construct a fresh source-only historical CS cohort centered on explicit formal conjectures, complexity bounds, program properties or public benchmark targets with objectively checkable endpoints; freeze source definitions before any future-outcome search and report whether outcome observability improves over the prior retrieval-focused cohort.
execution_requirements: objective endpoint rubric frozen before follow-up
task.failure_handling: If an endpoint is not objectively defined in the source, exclude it from the outcome-observable cohort and retain the exclusion; do not create labels from publication or citation counts.
success_criteria: source-only selection and cutoff provenance
objective endpoint and falsification rule per retained question
direct-label yield and missingness reported without Paper 3 scoring when sparse

task.objective: Run a predeclared local sensitivity check for the A1 source-style QAOA baseline using the same 20 graphs and parameters but an explicitly defined valid-set rule; quantify how the 16/20 denominator and paired delta change without tuning after observing the pilot.
task.failure_handling: If the raw graph set or frozen parameters do not verify, record an invalidation and do not substitute a new sample.
success_criteria: valid-set rule declared before recomputation
all 20 graph outcomes retained
conditional A1 effect and denominator reported with limitations

task.objective: Diagnose the direct-label bottleneck across the independently validated Paper 3 rounds without repeating keyword search: compare retrieval coverage, source eligibility, question-definition specificity, outcome-window structure, and trajectory missingness; identify which explanations are empirically supported and freeze the next cohort-selection rule.
execution_requirements: separate direct labels from trajectory dimensions
task.failure_handling: If a cause cannot be distinguished from bounded-search missingness, mark it unidentified; do not choose a cause from intuition or infer a prevalence estimate.
success_criteria: cause comparison has explicit denominators and exclusions
retrieval versus formulation/window explanations are separated
a changed next-selection rule or explicit stop decision is recorded

task.objective: Establish a concrete feasibility gate for the Avocado constrained-interaction-testing follow-up: pin source versions, reconstruct the constrained and unconstrained arms, verify objective invalid-test/detection/cost endpoints, and run a small real comparison only if both arms and a held-out configuration model are locally executable.
task.failure_handling: A missing solver, source, baseline or held-out model is a bounded no-go; do not substitute citation counts or a synthetic configuration benchmark.
success_criteria: source and endpoint definitions pinned
go/no-go based on actual local feasibility
if go, execute a bounded comparison; if no-go, preserve exact missing dependency and next improvement

task.objective: Apply the frozen PAPER3-DIRECT-ENDPOINT-COHORT-V1 rule to a new source-only cohort: require a public artifact or benchmark, source-pinned comparator, independently checkable endpoint and falsification condition before any future search; then audit dated primary follow-ups and stop expansion if high-coverage exact matching remains zero.
execution_requirements: diagnosis report and frozen selection rule
task.failure_handling: If fewer than six eligible artifact-gated questions survive, report selection attrition and do not use later outcomes to replace them; if the stop gate fires, move to experiment rather than repeating retrieval.
success_criteria: new source-only rule applied without hindsight
artifact/comparator/endpoint eligibility recorded
direct yield and the predeclared stop gate reported

task.objective: Use the Paper 3 stop-gate direction to audit whether the null-type mutation question has a locally executable, version-pinned endpoint-matched experiment: inspect the replication package, Java/build availability, named projects, traditional-mutant comparator and exact mutant-kill/subsumption outcomes; run only a bounded smoke if the full oracle is feasible.
task.failure_handling: Missing Java/build/package/oracle is a bounded no-go and must not be replaced with synthetic mutants, citation counts, or a different mutation endpoint.
success_criteria: endpoint tuple and source package audited
actual local feasibility decision
if infeasible, exact blocker and concrete enabling condition recorded

task.objective: Run a new, predeclared larger-n source-style QAOA A1 robustness experiment using exact local state vectors: sample 20 seeded simple 3-regular graphs at n=10, require the distance-at-least-3 conditioning event to be feasible on every graph or record setup failure, and compare graph-level conditioned versus unconditioned expected cut at the frozen beta/gamma without post-hoc filtering.
task.failure_handling: If any graph lacks the conditioning event, report the all-graph setup failure and do not silently drop it; do not tune beta/gamma or change the graph family after seeing outcomes.
success_criteria: 20 graph outcomes retained
all-graph feasibility or explicit setup failure
paired delta and graph-level uncertainty reported
no general or planner-utility claim
